title: Fragment refs: handle a group without a wrapper div

slides.say: Sometimes you want one listener or one observer for a group of elements, without adding a wrapper div. React 19.3 lets a Fragment take a ref.
The ref gets a Fragment instance. Add a listener once, and it applies to every button inside. Remove it in cleanup.

slides.text: Events and observers target the first-level DOM children. focus() searches deeper for the first focusable one.
slides.say: Listeners and observers target the top level DOM children only. Focus is different: it searches deeper and focuses the first element that can take focus.
One rule. The empty tag shorthand can't take a ref or a key. Import Fragment and write it out.
